messages.guide.chapter.start.title: Introduction
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.welcome: Some machines dig. This one §blistens§r. The Miner tunes into the frequency of the dimension it stands in and makes its ores appear out of nothing, without opening a single hole in the world. To get there you will rely on two allies: the §bMechanical Crusher§r and the §bAlloy Smelter§r. You can put the pickaxe away. Gently, it has feelings too.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.energy: Every machine in this guide feeds on §eenergy (FE)§r, which must come from generators of other mods. The blue bar of each machine shows how much it has stored. A machine without energy is just a very expensive, very pretty block.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.path:
§b0.§r Get an energy source (FE) from another mod: every machine runs on it.
§b1.§r Build the Crusher and the Smelter.
§b2.§r Crush iron, coal and calcite.
§b3.§r Smelt the three together and §ePure Steel§r is born.
§b4.§r With Pure Steel, forge the Reinforced Eye of Ender, the Miner parts and a core (see "Which core first?" in Running the Miner).
§b5.§r Build the Miner, hand it the core, give it power and press the button.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.interfa: The tabs on the sides of each machine hold its secrets: where things go in and out, details, upgrade, speed and redstone. If something goes wrong, a yellow triangle appears in the corner and tells you why. It does not judge. Much.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.slots: Machine slots follow the rules of a chest. Shortcut: sneak + right click with an upgrade or core in hand installs it straight into the block, no menus needed.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.viewer: With EMI or JEI, clicking the work chamber of a machine reveals everything it knows how to make.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.breakin: Moving house has a price. When a machine is broken, §eall its items§r drop: inputs, outputs, core and upgrade. The §estored energy§r, the work in progress and the Miner's §eDM§r are lost, and the side, speed and redstone settings do not travel with the block. The Smelter also pays out its stored experience as orbs.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.guide: Turn the pages with the arrows, the ←→ keys or the mouse wheel; the violet ribbon at the top goes back to the contents. Lost the book? It happens to the best explorers. A new one is born like this:
messages.guide.chapter.materials.title: Materials and recipes
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.ste: §ePure Steel§r is the only metal able to hold the flux: steel from other mods cracks under it. It is born in the Smelter from §eIron Dust, Coal Dust and Calcite Grains§r, and leaves a §eSlag§r behind, that relative who always tags along.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.sla: Nothing goes to waste: nine slag form an Aggregate, which the Smelter turns back into steel. Dimensional recycling, the planet thanks you.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.eye: An eye of ender armored with steel. It still points to strongholds but §enever breaks§r on the way. Finally, an eye that does not abandon you halfway through the trip.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.par: Twenty-seven parts form the Miner: chassis, ventilation, reinforced glass, ports, the quantum core and the terminal. Yes, you will need a lot of steel. Yes, it is worth it.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.dus: The Crusher grinds ingots, raw ores and gems into dust, and the furnace turns metal dusts back into ingots.
messages.guide.chapter.crusher.title: Mechanical Crusher
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.about: Steel jaws that grind any precious stone into grains. Keep your fingers away.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.ores: Every crushed ore gives §edouble§r the material, or §etriple§r with the Efficiency Upgrade. It works with ores of any mod. The prettiest math in Minecraft.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.dusts: Ingots, raw ores and gems become dust. Coal and calcite become the steel ingredients.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.slots: One input and four outputs. When no output has room, it stops and the outputs turn red with embarrassment.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.sides: Items dropped on top go in by themselves, so watch what you drop nearby. In the sides tab you choose where items and energy go in and out; Auto Input and Auto Eject talk to the neighboring chests.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.speed: From level 1 to 10 it goes from 1 item every 10 seconds up to 1 280 per second. The costs are in Speed and Upgrade.
messages.guide.chapter.smelter.title: Alloy Smelter
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.about: A furnace without flame: three lanes of electric heat that smelt and join metals. No coal was harmed in the making of this heat.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.modes:
§bFurnace Only:§r three independent furnaces.
§bAlloy + Furnace:§r when the lanes form an alloy, it is born; otherwise each lane smelts on its own.
§bAlloy Only:§r alloys only, which sometimes leave a byproduct (like the slag of steel).
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.bulk: Raw ore pays more here: §e2 raw become 3 ingots§r, or §e1 becomes 2§r with the Efficiency Upgrade. Somewhere, a stone furnace is crying.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.split: With Auto Split on, the Smelter shares the items among the free lanes by itself. Fairer than most pizza splits.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.outpu: Each lane has its own output. An alloy uses the first for its result and the second for the byproduct.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.lanes: In the modes with alloys, the Side Configuration gets three more colors: §6Input 1§r, §eInput 2§r and §dInput 3§r. A face with one of them sends everything to that lane only, so each alloy ingredient can arrive through its own pipe. The plain §cInput§r still shares between the three.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.xp: Recipe experience is kept as §eLiquid Experience§r: it leaves through pipes, or spills as orbs if the machine is broken. Breaking the Smelter just for XP is rude, but it works.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.xp_pi: Liquid Experience works with the XP tanks and pipes of other mods (1 XP point = 20 mB) and has its own Auto Eject, on the fluid tab of the Side Configuration.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.multi:
Use both machines together and every ore gives far more than the 1 ingot of a common furnace:
§bNo upgrades:§r 1 ore → 2 raw → §e3 ingots§r.
§bUpgrade in the Crusher only:§r 1 ore → 3 raw → §e4.5 ingots§r.
§bUpgrade in the Smelter only:§r 1 ore → 2 raw → §e4 ingots§r.
§bUpgrade in both:§r 1 ore → 3 raw → §e6 ingots§r.
This applies to ores that become raw ore, like iron, gold and copper.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.exter: Got EnderIO or Oritech? The alloys of their Alloy Smelter and Foundry run here too. With Create, andesite + an iron or zinc nugget makes Andesite Alloy.
messages.guide.chapter.assembly.title: Building the Miner
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.intr: Twenty-seven parts, one single purpose. Drag the model to rotate it, look at one layer at a time and hover a part in the list to see where it lives. Spin it all you want, it does not get dizzy.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.laye:
§bBase:§r 7 Dimensional Ports around, a Steel Chassis in the center and the Terminal in the front middle.
§bMiddle:§r the Quantum Core at the heart; Glass in front and on both sides; Steel Chassis in the corners and at the back.
§bTop:§r Glass in the center, front and sides; Ventilation in the corners and the back middle.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.fron: The Terminal faces the front of the machine. The ports of the base have nine faces: three on each side and three at the back. In §bSide Configuration§r you choose one face for the §bore output§r and, with the Stabilized Core, one for §bmatter§r (both may share a face). §bEnergy§r enters through any face: a port lights up where a cable touches it, or pick the faces yourself.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.buil: Hold the Terminal and the whole machine shows see-through where it would be built. Place the Terminal: the missing parts stay see-through in their places (a red outline means a block is in the way). Every click on it fits the next part from your inventory; with no part to place, the click hides or shows the preview. With the last part, the machine awakens. Flat-pack furniture was never this easy.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.powe: It awakens asleep: it only works after you press the power button. Redstone can put it to sleep, never wake it. Just like everyone on a Monday.
messages.guide.chapter.miner.title: Running the Miner
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.how: Channeling the very essence of the dimension, the Miner condenses the dimensional fabric and manifests the ores of that place, each according to its rarity. Every manifestation costs §e2 DM§r and energy. Without energy, without DM or with a full output, it rests. Well deserved, if you ask it.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.basic: §bDimensional Drain:§r stretches invisible roots for 300 blocks and harvests the dimensional energy that keeps the land standing, column by column (§e64 DM§r each). The price: without that energy, the matter of the place decays and the land becomes §ccorrupted§r. Your neighbors may not love the new decor. The Nether and the End have nothing to drain.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.stabili: §bMatter Injection:§r feed the matter port with stone and ores and it turns them into DM at once. §aThe landscape stays untouched§r, and that chest full of cobblestone is finally good for something.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.compare: §bWhich core first?§r The §bBasic§r one is cheaper and feeds itself, but only finds something to drain in the Overworld and corrupts the area. The §bStabilized§r one works in any dimension and never touches the landscape, but you have to feed it matter. Many start with the Basic core far from home and move to the Stabilized one later.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.loaded: The Drain only reaches §eloaded chunks§r. If you walk away, or without a chunk loader, it stops harvesting and the Miner runs out of DM.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.matter: Every item that goes into the matter port turns into DM at once. Only matter of the dimension the Miner stands in is accepted: Nether stone does not get through Overworld customs. §bObsidian§r is the only one accepted everywhere.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.matter_: §bOres§r only count in the dimension where they are born: §e0.5 DM§r each; diamond and uranium §e1 DM§r; emerald, platinum and ancient debris §e2 DM§r (with the upgrade up to +0.2, but an ore never gives more than the 2 DM it costs to make).

§bWith the Efficiency Upgrade§r, every injected item gives §e+0.2 DM§r on top of its value, or double its value when it is worth less (the last column of the table). On top of that, the ores the filter would discard are not lost: they come back as DM (up to 2 DM each).
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.termina: The Terminal screen tells how the machine is doing, which core it carries, what holds production back and how much DM is stored. It is its diary, just without secrets.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.buttons:
§bPower:§r wakes the machine up and puts it to sleep.
§bFilter:§r choose the ores you want; the rest returns to the void, no tears.
§bSide Configuration§r (tab on the left): the nine ports of the base, with Auto Input and Auto Eject.
Nothing but the Core slot works until a Core is inserted.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.filter: Mark only the ore families you want; with nothing marked, it keeps everything. The search box finds an ore by name or tag (right click clears it). The filter does not change the odds: a discarded attempt still costs energy and DM. With the Efficiency Upgrade, the discarded ore comes back as DM.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.redston: With Redstone Control on, a signal on the base becomes one more lock. Great for lever enthusiasts.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.output: Twenty-seven output slots. When full, the Miner stops and just stares at you. Keep it empty with pipes or Auto Eject.
messages.guide.chapter.automation.title: Automation and logistics
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.in: No machine here likes being fed by hand forever. This chapter gathers everything that connects the machines to the rest of your base.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.si: The tab with the faces icon, at the top left, opens the Side Configuration. Each material (items, energy, fluids) has its own tab. Left click on a face picks the next role, right click goes back. The batch button sets every face to the same role; with Shift, it clears everything.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.co: §cRed:§r item input. §6Orange§r, §eyellow§r and §dpink:§r the Smelter's Inputs 1, 2 and 3 in the modes with alloys. §9Blue:§r output. §5Purple:§r input and output on the same face. §bLight blue:§r energy, the same color as the energy bar. §aGreen:§r Liquid Experience output.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.au: §bAuto Input§r pulls from neighboring inventories through the input faces; §bAuto Eject§r pushes through the output faces. Each material has its own button: the item one cycles off, input, eject and both; Liquid Experience only has Auto Eject. Everything off? Pipes of other mods still work through the configured faces.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.re: On the Crusher and the Smelter, the redstone tab has three modes: §bIgnored§r (always works), §bNormal§r (only with a signal) and §bInverted§r (only without one). On the Miner, Redstone Control needs a signal on one of the nine bottom blocks, but never starts a machine stopped with its button.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.ca: The ports are smart: a cable or pipe that keeps §epulling items§r from a face gets the §bItem Output§r there, and one that keeps §epushing matter§r (with the Stabilized Core) gets the §bMatter Input§r. The face stays locked while the cable works and unlocks a few seconds after it stops; the role stays where it is.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.ne: §b100%% compatible with Logistics Networks:§r attach a node to a machine and it sets itself up, no screen needed.

A node on a machine sets the side by itself: a channel sending items becomes an output, one receiving becomes an input, received energy becomes an energy input and a sent fluid becomes the XP output. The side stays locked, with a frame, until the node leaves. On the Miner the node goes on a port: its box hides and the port gets a frame in the network's color.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.la: §bSmelter in an Alloy mode:§r a single input node feeds the three lanes. Added a second one? It understands you want separate ingredients and puts the first on Input 1 and the new one on Input 2; a third goes to Input 3. Clicking the face cycles All, Input 1, 2 and 3, and removing a node closes the gap in the sequence.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.ac: Tick accelerators (such as Soul Surge) work: each extra cycle is a complete cycle and pays its energy. On the Crusher and the Smelter, accelerate the block itself; on the Miner, only the eight bottom blocks around the Terminal (the ports and the center steel) take it.
messages.guide.chapter.dimensions.title: Dimensions
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.in: The Miner is §bdimensional§r: the dimension it stands in decides which ores it manifests and which matter it accepts. Matter from another dimension does not get through the port, however hard you insist.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ov: Both cores work here. The §bBasic Core§r drains the energy of the land and §cDimensional Death§r spreads. The §bStabilized Core§r accepts stone, deepslate, granite, diorite, andesite and terracotta (§e0.5 DM§r), cobblestone and sand (§e0.3 DM§r), grass blocks (§e0.2 DM§r) and dirt (§e0.1 DM§r), plus every ore born in the Overworld.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ne: The Nether was born corrupted: there is nothing left to drain, so §eonly the Stabilized Core§r works here, and the Miner corrupts nothing. It accepts netherrack, basalt, blackstone, nylium and magma blocks (§e0.5 DM§r), glowstone, soul sand and soul soil (§e1 DM§r), nether bricks (§e1.5 DM§r) and the Nether's own ores.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.en: The End has nothing left to lose either: §eonly the Stabilized Core§r works, corrupting nothing. It accepts end stone and purpur blocks (§e0.5 DM§r) and the ores born in the End. Where few ore families are born, §ethe void§r takes part of the attempts: 97%% with a single family, about 93%%, 83%% and 58%% with two, three and four, none from five on. Those attempts find nothing but still cost their energy and DM.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.eg: §bDragon egg:§r you beat the dragon, put the egg on a shelf and now you look at it thinking of DM? The Miner takes it: §e10 DM§r in one go. There is no other one, there are no refunds, and the dragon, wherever it is, is judging you.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ba: On barren planets and desolate worlds of other mods, the land holds no energy worth harvesting: the §bBasic Core§r finds nothing to drain and only the §bStabilized§r one works. Each world has its own stones, and they are matter only there.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.di: These are only the best-known materials. The matter of each dimension hides in many shapes: cut, polished, shaped by builders' hands. Bring to the Miner's port whatever you find along the way; it knows what belongs to its place.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.or: An ore only becomes matter in the dimension where it is born, and only that variant: Overworld diamond ore does not get into the Nether, and Nether quartz does not get into the Overworld. If a mod generates that same ore in another dimension, it counts there too. This applies to the matter port and to the automatic input from chests alike.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ob:
§bObsidian§r has always defied conventional physics. The same raw dimensional properties that stabilize and tear open the rifts to other planes keep its crystal structure suspended in a constant temporal limbo.
Bound to the laws of no single reality, it turns into matter in §eany dimension§r without decay or collapse: §e1 DM§r everywhere. What sustains this timeless resonance is still a mystery... Further studies are advised before any large-scale application.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.mo: In dimensions of other mods, the Miner manifests and accepts the ores born there. Which stones of each world also count as matter? That is for explorers to find out.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ta: The value of every item is in the table of the Running the Miner chapter.
messages.guide.chapter.rates.title: Speed and Upgrade
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.intro: There is no speed upgrade to craft here. Every machine has a §bSpeed selector from 1 to 10§r (the tab with colored strips: left click goes up, right click goes down) and sips FE at whatever pace you ask. Your power generation is the boss, not your crafting table: early on it works slowly on a simple generator; late game, with a reactor, it flies. The same machine follows you from the first ingot to the last dragon.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.buffer: Every operation costs the same energy at every level: a higher level works faster and asks for more FE/t in the same proportion, with no discount and no penalty. The internal storage holds 10 ticks of the selected level, and the machine only charges for the work it really does: when idle, it spends nothing. Lowering the level never throws energy away.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.miner_n: Ores and DM per second at full power. Every attempt always costs the same energy, even the ones the filter discards. The Efficiency Upgrade does not change its thirst.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.crusher: Operations/s = items crushed per second. At level 10 it goes past a thousand per second: bring pipes that can keep up.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.smelter: Items per second of each lane for a common furnace recipe (10 s); there are 3 lanes. The FE/t is that of the 3 lanes smelting; an alloy costs less per execution, and only the work done is charged. At level 10 each lane runs 64 items per tick, 192 for the three; every slot holds only 64 items, so the raw bonus is limited by its output.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.upgrade: One single, expensive upgrade that goes into the Upgrade tab (or sneak + right click on the machine).

§bCrusher:§r half the energy and 3 products per ore instead of 2.
§bSmelter:§r half the energy and a raw bonus of 1 → 2 instead of 2 → 3.
§bMiner:§r energy unchanged; every item in the Matter Input gives up to +0.2 DM (never more than its own value), and every ore discarded by the filter returns DM (up to 2 DM).
messages.guide.chapter.blight.title: Dimensional Death
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.intro: The Drain takes its toll. Dimensional energy is the glue that holds the whole world together; where the Drain harvests it, the structure of the place falls apart, life withers and the land rots forever. Think twice before installing it next to grandma's house.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.terrai: Dirt, grass and stone darken, terracotta becomes §eCorrupted Terracotta§r and sand and gravel become §eCorrupted Sediment§r. Dimensional Death reaches through trees and buildings, and flowers turn into wither roses. A lovely gift for people you do not like.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.water: Water touched by Dimensional Death turns purple and sinks, corrupting the water below it, layer by layer. No land plant drinks from it; only sea life endures. No, it is not grape juice.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.creatu: Corrupted water hurts players and peaceful creatures but is a balm for hostile ones. You would not want to face a drowned bathed in it.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.protec: Dimensional Death respects borders. Land claimed with §bFTB Chunks§r or §bOpen Parties and Claims§r is only corrupted if the Miner's owner may build there; the spawn protection and the regions the server protects are never touched, and Corrupted Water does not cross those borders. It also never hydrates farmland or sugar cane.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.avoid: Want to mine without hurting the land? The Stabilized Dimensional Core never touches the environment. The server's environmentalists approve.
messages.guide.chapter.trouble.title: Why did my machine stop?
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.trouble.intro: Every stopped machine has a reason, and it always tells you. On the Miner, the Terminal screen shows the state in big letters and the §bLIMIT§r line says what holds production back. On the Crusher and the Smelter, hover the yellow triangle in the corner.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.trouble.miner:
§bMULTIBLOCK INVALID:§r a part is missing or in the wrong place. Click the Terminal to see the preview.
§bCORE REQUIRED:§r insert a core.
§bMANUAL STOP:§r press the power button.
§bREDSTONE HALT:§r Redstone Control is on and the base has no signal.
§bOUTPUT BLOCKED:§r the output is full; empty it with pipes or Auto Eject.
§bWAITING FOR ENERGY:§r not enough FE; check the cables or lower the speed.
§bWAITING FOR MATTER:§r the Stabilized core has no DM; feed the matter port with matter of this dimension.
§bNO DRAINABLE MATTER:§r the Basic core finds nothing to drain: a lifeless dimension, everything already corrupted, protected land or unloaded chunks.
§bDIMENSIONAL SURVEY:§r the Basic core is mapping the land; wait a moment.
§bNO RESOURCES IN THIS DIMENSION:§r the dimension generates no known ore.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.trouble.machi:
§bNO INPUT:§r nothing to process.
§bNO RECIPE:§r the item has no recipe here; on the Smelter, check the mode and that every busy lane is part of the alloy.
§bOUTPUT BLOCKED:§r the outputs are full.
§bWAITING FOR ENERGY / LOW ENERGY:§r less FE arrives than the speed level asks for.
§bREDSTONE HALT:§r the redstone mode is blocking it.
messages.guide.dimensionalfluxminer.trouble.energ: Low energy is almost always solved by lowering the speed level to what your generation can hold. The machine never works for free: with little FE it just goes slower.
